__**Avrae Guide!**__
These are the basics. Feel free to explore, or ask <@!594008151779573762> if you have any questions regarding things Avrae doesn't support automatically, like Sneak Attack or something.
```
!update
 Reloads your character. Use this command when you make changes to your sheet (levelling up, etc), otherwise Avrae won't see them.

!roll [dice]
 Rolls what you tell it to, plain and simple. Anything you type after the dice becomes the title of the roll. Can be abbreviated to !r. 

!check [skill]
 Rolls an ability check. Initiative is rolled with this command. Can be abbreviated to !c.

!attack [name]
 Rolls an attack and damage roll using one of the attacks listed in your character sheet. Type !attack without anything afterward to see a list of your attacks. Can be abbreviated to !a.

!save [ability]
 Rolls a saving throw of the chosen ability score. Can be abbreviated to !s.

!spell [name]
 Looks up a spell and tells you everything about it.

!game
 This one does nothing on its own, but has many functions for keeping track of your character when you expand it like below. It can also be abbreviated to !g.
  !game hp [number]
    Adds the number to your HP. Type a negative number to subtract HP when you take damage.
  !game thp [number]
    Same as above except with temporary hit points.
  !game spellslot [level] [number]
    Adds or expends a number spell slots of the chosen level. Type !game spellslot with nothing afterward to view your spell slots. Can be abbreviated to !g ss.
  !game deathsave [reset]
    Rolls a death saving throw and keeps track of them. Type 'reset' after the command to wipe your death saves instead of making one. Can be abbreviated to !g ds.

Add adv or dis to your command to roll with advantage or disadvantage. Add -b [bonus] to add to your checks, saves, and attack rolls, and -d [bonus] to add to your damage rolls. Finally, add -rr [number] to roll more than once.
```

**DMs!** These commands are mostly for you!

```
!rr [iterations] [dice]
 Like !r, but it rolls the dice as many times as you tell it to, displays all the rolls separately, then adds them for convenience. Useful for rolling damage from multiattacks.

!rrr [iterations] [dice] [dc]
 Like !rr, except instead of adding them together, it tells you how many of the rolls beat your DC.
```
